cleared.text: Cleared. Please enter the last four digits again.

continue.text: To continue in English, press hash.

enter.text: Please enter the last four digits of your loan application number.

greeting.text: Welcome to Saral. To change language, press nine.

locked.text: I couldn't verify you, so I can't discuss account details on this call. I can connect you to a member of our team instead.

needs_verification.text: Before I can discuss your account, I need to verify you.

no_match.text: That didn't match. Please try again.

timeout.text: I didn't receive any keypresses, so I've stopped verification. Please say something to try again, or I can connect you to a member of our team.

unavailable.text: I'm sorry, I can't verify callers right now, so I can't share account details on this call. I can connect you to a member of our team.

unknown_caller.text: I'm sorry, I can't find an account linked to this phone number, so I can't share account details on this call. I can connect you to a member of our team.
